reviews.title: Without real vehicle data, ABRP loses its purpose!
reviews.text:
Very disappointed! I used ABRP to plan my journeys using real-time data from my Porsche, including battery level and energy consumption.
Unfortunately, the Porsche connection is no longer available.
Without this information, how can we trust the estimated driving range and recommended charging stops?
If Porsche is no longer supported today, which car manufacturer will be next tomorrow?
Without reliable, real-time vehicle data, ABRP loses its main advantage and becomes little more than a basic navigation app.
Very disappointing for an application that is supposed to make electric vehicle route planning easier and more accurate.

reviews.title: Misleading Premium Subscription
reviews.text:
The description for the premium subscription implies that purchasing it will let you connect the app to your car via Bluetooth to obtain real-time telemetry for state of charge.

This is false.

Purchasing premium allows the app to work with OTHER apps, that work with ODBII dongles, which you ALSO have to buy and subscribe to.  ABRP cannot connect to your vehicle on its own.

The purchase is therefore a bait-and-switch.  You pay expecting to get a feature, but that feature doesn’t work, unless you pay even more to buy something else.

Additionally, the CarPlay UI is horrific and confusing.  The map is ugly and jittery.  Buttons are non-intuitive, and pushing them has irreversible consequences; you WILL wind up rerouting yourself to a non-optimal route while just trying to figure out where you’re going or change the map view.  The voice callouts use the old assistive voices instead of your Siri voice.

reviews.title: Don’t bother
reviews.text:
Update August 2026
I decided to give it another go as I had some long journeys to do. Managed to log in ok and pay for a subscription, and pleased to see live data working again. Not pleased to see the new CarPlay layout which is very cluttered - was much better when charge level and speed were in top left and bottom left corners. The speed display overlaps the speed limit which is messy to look at. Charge remaining is very inaccurate - when setting off it plans for a charge at  15% but during the journey it gradually updates to as much as 40% remaining, but does not replan the charger accordingly. Often when forced to detour it does not replan the route and instead freezes until reset. Speed camera alerts are generally out of date. Traffic is also generally inaccurate. There is a lot of work needed to make this usable. 

Update June 2025
Since the latest update it is now impossible to log in to the app. This is such a shame as it had started to become ans excellent app, but it has now dropped back to being absolutely awful. I am now cancelling my subscription. 

Update May 2025:
The most recent set of updates to this app have caused serious problems that are making it unusable. The main issue is that for the last few updates it can only connect to my OBD dongle for a couple of seconds at a time, then disconnects for several seconds, and repeats. 

Original review:
ABRP is starting to get good now. Speed cameras and CarPlay Dashboard screen are very welcome additions. I drive

Some sketchy rural areas. And the speed limit shown on the app was almost always wrong. My biggest gripe was that it took me to a charger that doesn’t seem to exist (it had a 1 start rating). Why would you take me there?

reviews.title: Used to be awesome, not so much anymore.
reviews.text: I used to use this app all the time to plan trips, and while it was a little quirky, it was always extremely helpful to plan trips and charges in a Tesla. Not so much anymore. I can’t now set my initial SOC (at least not simply, I haven’t found out how to do it at all so far. It used to be so simple), and my paths seem to need to route back to where I started from giving me really weird driving times. It might be “a better route”, but it is certainly not a “planner” anymore. Maybe you should change the name to just ABR.

reviews.title: 30 day trial ended in 7 hours
reviews.text:
I was excited to try ABRP for a trip to a new area for the long weekend. We know nothing of the area, so relying on charging with the app was essential. I signed up for a 30 day trial, thinking that I would get a yearly membership if it worked out. 

Well, the trial cut me off after 7 hours. There is not live support. So, we are just stuck without the features we need for essentially the entire trip. 

If you need reliability for your trip, ABRP is not your app.

reviews.title: Good grief
reviews.text: This was already not the easiest planning tool, but I figured it out. Then they did a refresh to help and it’s now officially impossible. Deleted and done.

reviews.title: Worst EV App I’ve ever downloaded
reviews.text:
This had to be the worst app I have used with my EV. It tried to route me to a charger that was out of range, regardless of what I did and settings I changed it kept trying to route me to an out of range charger I had to set my min battery to 40% before it added an in-range charger, but then there were more problems. On top of trying to route to out of range chargers, it also routed me to an incompatible Tesla charger (I have the Tesla app and an adapter). 

Not to mention it forces you to buy the premium version to use with CarPlay. 

I switched back to using Google Maps; will never use this app and I will be contacting Apple support for a refund.

reviews.title: Can’t get back to planning screen
reviews.text: This app is so glitchy. I started a route and now no matter what I do (even close the app and reopen) I can’t get back to the previous screen. It’s just stuck on navigating.

reviews.title: Weird backtracking
reviews.text: This app works well about 75% of the time. It won’t allow me to update the current battery manually while in route. Sometimes, it completely resets it to a full charge too. It also will randomly send me to the exist past the charging station and have me backtrack. It is maddening. It seemed to work a little better a couple months ago. The concept is great and it is helpful *some* of the time. There were a few times that I started to get worried about the battery getting too low because of the poor navigation.

reviews.title: Missing cost of trip.
reviews.text:
I used to really like ABRP, but removing or hiding the trip charging cost feature has made the app much less useful for me. One of the main reasons I used ABRP was to quickly see an estimated total charging cost for a trip, and now I either can’t find it or it no longer shows reliably.

That feature was extremely helpful for planning long EV road trips and budgeting before leaving. Without it, the app feels incomplete and more frustrating to use. I don’t want to dig through every charging stop or guess the cost manually — the total trip cost should be easy to see.

Please bring back the clear estimated charging cost display. It was one of the best parts of the app.

reviews.title: Still missing quality
reviews.text: . I have the fonts on my iPhone 17 slightly larger than the default. This renders the application unusable. For an application that claims to be better I would anticipate basic quality assurance to catch this sort of thing

reviews.title: Absolute Tripe.
reviews.text: What a load of rubbish. Had to pay for a months subscription to find my car nots listed. Contacted support and heard nothing.

reviews.title: Just start over
reviews.text: I have never seen a more confused UI in my life. Just start over. Next time use a simple project file metaphor, where you can load and save projects, but have those buttons be accessible from anywhere in the app. Use entry fields with acknowledgments. On the web interface prevent the user from hitting a single button (left arrow) and losing hours of planning work. Poof gone! This app and web site are so mind numbingly unintuitive. I would advise anyone to avoid this app like the plague. Sadly, it is probably still the best app for EV trip planning. If you do nothing else, fix the plan loading and saving interface to something straightforward. Stop trying to be clever and Apple-esque.

reviews.title: Flawed
reviews.text:
I really thought that this looked good but decided to only subscribe for 1 month - and really glad that I did.  

Yes, it runs in CarPlay but first I couldn’t get it to move from “Satellite Mapping” where it wasn’t anywhere near as good as Google Maps back to the standard ABRP map.  I had to remove the app altogether before I could get it to do it.

Then, having got it sorted I tried to load a route from CarPlay and all it did was display a large red box with “Loading” on it for the next twenty minutes!  Just gave up and deleted it from my iPhone.  Should really be named AWRP I’m afraid.

reviews.title: Que se passe-t-il avec ABRP ?

Ce n’est pas la réalité que ce soit avec Enode ou Tronity. Je suis extrêmement déçu je suspend définitivement mon abonnement. 

En plus j’ai de la pub sur comparer des véhicules EV (j’en ai pas besoin j’ai un véhicule électrique) je test l’application PUMP est pour l’instant il me va tees simple tout ce qu’on demande. Nous aidez à recharger sur l’itinéraire.

As well, I looked in this app to find some of my favorite DCFC that I use on routine trips and they were completely missing from this app.  I like the interface of this app, but if it is going to give me bad routes, it’s not very useful then.

reviews.title: Overrated stubborn app
reviews.text: There is a major issue with this app, even though I’m paying monthly. The app recommends stops which are not optimal and then does not allow you to delete them even though you add more stops to it it keeps the original recommendation in place even though you created another step 5 miles down the road. There is no way to delete. I would totally recommend to avoid this app.

reviews.title: Charge Icons Gone
reviews.text: Please bring back the charge station icons. It is incredibly irritating to have to tap on every plug icon to see which charge company runs the location.

reviews.title: Ajout nouveau chargeur impossible
reviews.text:
L’application ne permet pas d’ajouter un nouveau chargeur et qui n’est pas sur la carte ABRP
Vraiment nul qu’il n’y est pas la possibilité
J’ai même essayé d’envoyer un émail chez eux, ils ne répondent même pas !!

reviews.title: Never Ending Bugs
reviews.text: This app has been out for how long and it always has bugs. You’d think for a subscription based app they’d have it their act together.

reviews.title: Hondalink
reviews.text: I paid for an annual subscription in January. It worked great with HondaLink for about three weeks then it stopped working and a BRP support is blaming Honda link. But my HondaLink app has actually been working much better than before with quicker updates ABRP no longer provides me updates to my mileage battery percentage so essentially useless for why I purchased it. I would not use if you’re a Honda owner. locating charge centers works really well. That’s a positive.

reviews.title: Wrong cost data
reviews.text: While overall, the software is ok, it keeps defaulting to Stadtwerks Sennal for the cost per kilowatt. Even if I input Tesla Owner card. This is true for Tesla Superchargers as well as other stations. VERY frustrating.

reviews.title: Not User Friendly
reviews.text: I just want to set my home location and have been trying for hours but cannot find out how to do it. Very poor documentation and online help.

reviews.title: Good but could do better
reviews.text: I find the screen or CarPlay far too cluttered and distracting. It would be good to be able to turn off some of the info. I also find the battery charge remaining overly pessimistic. I have to keep updating it manually. It also overheat my phone and crashes the app. I’m not very impressed.

reviews.title: Please bring back the old feature set - I didn’t pay a years subscription for whatever v7 is.
reviews.text: ABRP was never pretty but it was incredibly functional and provided great insight into the state and capability of your EV(s). With V7 much of this is gone and as a result it’s no longer worth the annual subscription fee.

reviews.title: Actively becoming worse
reviews.text: This app used to be incredibly helpful. With the newest release, their development team has stripped out a lot of features in favor of a more streamlined UX. Admittedly, it looks prettier - I didn’t use it because it was pretty though; I used it because it was a powerful tool. It’s too bad they took something great and actively decided to make it middling.

reviews.title: New version is inferior!
reviews.text: I miss the slide bar for state of charge at destination in the main screen and as a slide bar in general. Also used to be able to toggle between faster route vs more or less stops. Sheesh.

reviews.title: Publicité trompeuse
reviews.text:
En me connectant à l’application pour préparer un trajet j’ai reçu une publicité m’indiquant la possibiltite d’avoir Apple Car Play sur mon véhicule via l’application ABRP et l’abonnement premium.
Toutefois aucune mention n’indique que certains véhicule (Tesla par exemple) ne peuvent pas bénéficier de cette fonctionnalité.
De plus l’application n’arrive même pas à se connecter à un modèle Tesla Juniper récent.
Grosse déception et l’impression d’avoir été pris pour un pigeon.
Une demande de remboursement est en cours. À voir si le service client a au moins l’honnête de rembourser. Si ce n’est pas le cas une déclaration auprès de la DGCCRF et des association de consommateur !

reviews.title: Navigating like I have a paper map
reviews.text: The app doesn't do any recalculation for the route if you miss a turn or anything.  And apparently it cannot connect to my Kia anymore.  Maybe partner with smart car, they seem to be able to fetch the data reliably

reviews.title: So many issues
reviews.text: I wish I could find something positive. You pay a subscription and you get an app with a map that looks like it was taken from TomTom in 2002, says you can change this bizarre robotic voice and you can’t. Good luck trying to enter a destination while on the road, and the worst issue was - I was in Belgium and France and the app wants to start navigation from a different city, miles away. This app needs to be removed from the App Store as it genuinely gets no development.

reviews.title: Offline?
reviews.text: The map doesn’t display road closures in the UK, at least those I came across. The main issue for me is the lack of offline maps, both in the countryside where mobile signals are poor, and when abroad.
